test_m3 = '''"""Tests for milestone m3: Save name/html/data-toc-label tokens and unescape before slugify."""

import pytest


def test_toc_tokens_has_three_keys():
    """Test that each toc_tokens entry contains 'name', 'html', and 'data-toc-label' keys.

    R4/R5 require all three keys to be present in every toc_tokens entry.
    """
    import markdown
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
    md.convert('# Foo & Bar{: data-toc-label="Custom & Label"}')
    tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(tokens) >= 1
    entry = tokens[0]
    assert 'name' in entry
    assert 'html' in entry
    assert 'data-toc-label' in entry


def test_name_preserves_entities():
    """Test that the 'name' field preserves HTML entities (not unescaped).

    R6 requires that html.unescape is NOT applied to name.
    """
    import markdown
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
    md.convert('# Foo & Bar{: data-toc-label="Custom & Label"}')
    tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(tokens) >= 1
    name = tokens[0]['name']
    # Entities should be preserved in name
    assert '&' in name or 'Custom' in name


def test_data_toc_label_preserved_raw():
    """Test that data-toc-label stores the raw unescaped attribute value.

    The data-toc-label must be the raw unescaped attribute value.
    """
    import markdown
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
    md.convert('# Foo & Bar{: data-toc-label="Custom & Label"}')
    tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(tokens) >= 1
    data_toc_label = tokens[0]['data-toc-label']
    # The raw value should be preserved
    assert 'Custom' in data_toc_label


def test_slug_uses_unescape_before_slugify():
    """Test that the generated id/slug uses html.unescape before slugify.

    R6 requires that html.unescape is called immediately before slugify.
    So '&' becomes '&' before slugification, yielding e.g. 'custom-label'.
    """
    import markdown
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
    md.convert('# Foo & Bar{: data-toc-label="Custom & Label"}')
    tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(tokens) >= 1
    entry_id = tokens[0]['id']
    # The slug should be derived from unescaped label: "Custom & Label" -> "custom-label"
    # If html.unescape was NOT applied before slugify, we would get something like "custom-amp-label"
    # The correct behavior: unescape first gives "Custom & Label", then slugify gives "custom-label"
    assert entry_id == 'custom-label' or 'custom' in entry_id.lower()


def test_html_field_contains_rich_markup():
    """Test that the 'html' field contains the rendered heading inner markup."""
    import markdown
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
    md.convert('# Foo & Bar{: data-toc-label="Custom & Label"}')
    tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(tokens) >= 1
    html_content = tokens[0]['html']
    # The html field should contain the rich inner HTML of the heading
    assert isinstance(html_content, str)
    assert len(html_content) > 0


def test_entity_not_unescaped_in_name_or_html_or_data_toc_label():
    """Test that html.unescape is NOT applied to name, html, or data-toc-label.

    R6 constraint: html.unescape must NOT be applied to these fields.
    Only the slug/id derivation should use html.unescape.
    """
    import markdown
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
    md.convert('# Test & Entity{: data-toc-label="Label & Value"}')
    tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(tokens) >= 1
    entry = tokens[0]
    # None of the three fields should have unescaped entities
    name = entry['name']
    html_val = entry['html']
    dtl = entry['data-toc-label']
    # Check that & appears as & not as & in the stored values
    # (unless it was part of the original text without being an entity reference)
    if '&' in name or '&' in dtl:
        pass  # Good - entities preserved
'''
